questions.question: What are three ways a brand can resolve low email engagement?
options: Send generalized promotions to cast a wide net
Remove all inactive users from the email list
Segment email list to engage only loyal and active users
Ensure explicit consent is obtained from users before sending
questions.explanation: Segmenting the email list to engage specifically with loyal and active users helps improve overall engagement metrics.

questions.question: What is the Braze Query Builder?
options: A tool to see overall frequency and location of clicks within the campaign lifespan
A high-volume data export tool for granular and comprehensive data view
A robust data export tool allowing custom SQL queries for bespoke questions
A data export tool with every individual send, open, click, bounce event
questions.explanation: The Braze Query Builder is a robust data export tool that allows you to use custom SQL queries to ask specific questions about your data.
